## Problem or use case

Who needs this and what are they trying to accomplish?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the improvement and a concrete example of the desired workflow.

## Scope and acceptance criteria

Describe the boundaries and observable conditions that would make this complete.

## Alternatives considered

Describe existing features, workarounds, or other approaches you considered.

## UI and operator impact

Describe how users or operators would inspect and manage the new behavior,
or explain why no application UI adaptation is needed. Link related UI work.

## Dependencies and additional context

Link related issues and note relevant architecture, compatibility, security,
or data-handling considerations.
